episodeTitle.en: How a Meta PM ships products without ever writing code | Zevi Arnovitz
episodeTitle.zh: Meta产品经理如何无需写代码就能交付产品 | 泽维·阿诺维茨

guestBioOfficial.en: Zevi Arnovitz is a product manager at Meta with no technical background who has figured out how to build and ship real products using AI. His engineering team at Meta asks him to teach them how he does what he does. In this episode, Zevi breaks down his complete AI workflow that allows non-technical people to build sophisticated products with Cursor. *We discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 泽维·阿诺维茨是Meta的产品经理，虽无技术背景，却成功利用AI打造并交付真实产品。他的工程团队请他传授方法。在本期节目中，泽维将解析完整的AI工作流程，让非技术人员也能借助Cursor打造复杂产品。*我们将探讨：*

title.en: How a Meta PM ships products without ever writing code | Zevi Arnovitz
title.zh: Meta产品经理如何无需写代码就能交付产品 | 泽维·阿诺维茨

summary.en: Zevi shares his remarkably practical workflow for building real software as a non-technical PM, using AI coding tools like Cursor and Claude Code. He explains how he scopes, iterates, and ships products solo, and offers a copyable system any non-technical product person can adopt. The episode is an empowering, concrete demonstration that the AI tooling shift has rewritten what a PM without code can do.
summary.zh: Zevi 分享了他作为非技术型 PM、用 Cursor 和 Claude Code 这类 AI 编程工具构建真正软件的、异常务实的工作流。他解释了自己如何界定范围、迭代并独自交付产品，并给出了任何非技术产品人都可复制的系统。本期是一次赋能性的、具体的演示：AI 工具的变革已经重写了“没有代码的 PM”所能做到的事。
